text: Apple is a global technology company known for iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch, and services such as the App Store and iCloud. Growth depends on hardware demand, ecosystem loyalty, and recurring services revenue.
Microsoft is a leading software and cloud company known for Windows, Office, Azure, and enterprise software. Growth depends on cloud adoption, AI services, and subscription revenue.
NVIDIA is a semiconductor company known for GPUs used in gaming, AI, and data centers. Performance depends on chip demand, AI growth, and computing trends.
Amazon is a global e-commerce and cloud company known for online retail, logistics, Prime, and AWS. Growth depends on consumer spending and cloud demand.
Alphabet is the parent company of Google. Revenue comes mainly from search advertising, YouTube, and cloud services. Growth depends on ad demand and AI innovation.
Meta owns Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp. Revenue is driven by digital advertising, user engagement, and AI-powered ad targeting.
Tesla is an electric vehicle and battery company. Stock performance depends on deliveries, margins, battery innovation, and EV competition.
Berkshire Hathaway is a diversified holding company with insurance, railroads, utilities, and stock investments. Performance reflects broad economic activity.
JPMorgan Chase is a major global bank involved in consumer banking, investment banking, and asset management. Earnings depend on rates and economic activity.
Visa is a global electronic payments network. Growth depends on consumer spending, travel, and digital payment adoption.
Eli Lilly is a pharmaceutical company known for diabetes, obesity, and oncology drugs. Growth depends on successful drug launches and approvals.
Johnson & Johnson is a diversified healthcare company with pharmaceuticals and medical technology. Often viewed as a defensive stock.
Walmart is one of the world's largest retailers. Growth depends on grocery demand, pricing power, and consumer spending.
Costco is a warehouse retailer driven by membership revenue, customer loyalty, and value pricing.
Exxon Mobil is a global oil and gas company. Earnings depend heavily on crude oil and natural gas prices.
Chevron is a multinational energy company involved in oil and gas exploration and refining. Performance follows commodity cycles.
TSMC is the world's leading semiconductor foundry manufacturing chips for major technology companies. Growth depends on AI and smartphone chip demand.
ASML makes lithography machines essential for advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Growth depends on global chip investment.
Procter & Gamble sells household and personal care products. Revenue is supported by recurring consumer demand.
Netflix is a streaming entertainment company. Growth depends on subscribers, pricing, and successful content releases.
